'''Deniv Corsignis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who headed the [[Corsignis Property Alliance]], a trading concern that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
